speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This was done at around the same time as the operations in the Sin Ming Avenue area.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: And although there is a recent news report that gave the impression this happened after my reply to the Parliamentary Question, this was not the case.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: There are many bird flu strains and the virus has been known to mutate.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Through research studies and public engagement efforts, AVA aims to enhance its management of animal populations, including the free-roaming chickens.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: AVA will involve stakeholders like academics, wildlife experts, the community and animal welfare groups in exploring various approaches and solutions to this problem.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Thirdly, is AVA planning to engage the NCs in that area because I think they had some concerns?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: This time round, I have personally seen those chickens; there are red junglefowls there.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: This definitely has an economic impact from the Malaysian side.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: Being so close to home, AVA takes a risk-based approach to mitigate the risk to our own country, to our own people.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: We have to understand that this is not just about the chickens, it is also about public safety and human health.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: At the end of the day, AVA also has a responsibility towards the health and safety of Singaporeans.
